Interface SlotScroll.Cell

Enclosing class:
SlotScroll
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public static interface SlotScroll.Cell
Makes cell index: an element at (x, y) in the grid, shown while shown holds (on top of whatever hides it on its own). Called once per cell, and once more per cell for the narrow set of a grid that narrows.
